shocked.emotion: Wide-eyed alarm or disbelief, open mouth; high intensity.
shocked.fits: Unexpected disaster, sudden danger, unbelievable reversal, an actual shocking payoff.
shocked.avoid: Routine explanations, calm advice, confident recommendations.

hold-on.emotion: Hands raised, skeptical or playful objection; animated but not purely excited.
hold-on.fits: Questioning a strange choice, a funny contradiction, wait-what moments, suspicious builds.
hold-on.avoid: Straightforward dominance or a calm instructional claim.

overly-hyped.emotion: Clenched fists and closed eyes; an extreme, over-the-top emotional peak.
overly-hyped.fits: RARE use only: exceptionally explosive, genuinely extreme hype supported by the video's actual event or reaction. Explain why a smiling photo would undersell this moment.
overly-hyped.avoid: Ordinary wins, strong but routine plays, build/strategy explanations, mild curiosity, playful experiments. Exciting is not enough: choose smiling unless the hype is truly exceptional.

smiling.emotion: Genuine broad smile, relaxed amusement; positive rather than alarmed.
smiling.fits: Preferred for most positive hooks: playful experimentation, satisfying success, cheeky unexpected picks, humorous confidence, normal excitement and strong plays that are not an exceptional emotional peak.
smiling.avoid: Serious disaster, an angry rant, genuinely alarming stakes.
